request.subject: ICON:ACTION:BROOD

layers.text: Change only two things: erase the small orange flames on top of the three heads, and erase the flat cream plate under them, leaving nothing behind. Do not redraw anything else: keep the three teal one-eyed heads, their grins, the glowing green thread round them, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
